dependency_reason: The executable declaration is conditional on this environment variable.
The two supplied strings become the OBJ and material streams.
The local streams remain alive for the LoadObj call.
The parser finalizes groups and attributes before returning.
The fixed config supplies triangulate and vertex_color to LoadObj.
Vertex-color fallback changes the processing of vertex records.
Triangulate is passed to shape export.
